basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old avid Pokémon fan from the UK. By day, I work as a software developer, but by night, you'll find me on my Nintendo Switch completing my Pokédex or exploring new game strategies. I'm not a fan of spoilers and prefer to figure things out on my own. I'm currently single and enjoy gaming marathons with friends online, typically during late evenings and weekends. Besides gaming, I love cycling and am part of a local cycling club. Always up for a good trade, so hit me up!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science, which has fueled my passion for technology and gaming. I have been into Pokémon since my childhood, and over the years, I've become quite knowledgeable about the various games and strategies through self-learning and community interaction.
